claims.content: The system has captured the master details of every distributor (Distributor Master Information).
The system has captured the details of MSIU Salesmen (MSIU Sales Team Information Master).
Vouchers have been previously sold to a distributor by the VMU sales team.
The user is authorized to access the 'Voucher Sales Return' module.
A distributor decides to return vouchers back to the MSIU sales team.

trigger.raw_text: A distributor decides to return vouchers back to the MSIU sales team.

claims.content: The VMU User initiates the 'Voucher Sales Return' feature in the system.
The user selects the Distributor Name from the list populated from the Distributor Master.
The user selects the Sales Man Name from the list populated from the Sales Man Master.
The user enters the Sales Return Date (defaults to current system date but can be adjusted).
The system automatically calculates and displays the Sales Return Amount based on the number of vouchers returned multiplied by the wholesale sale rate.
The user enters the transaction details: Batch No and Voucher No for each voucher being returned.
The system validates that the returned vouchers were originally sold to the selected distributor; if not, it rejects those vouchers.
Upon successful validation, the system records the return transaction and updates inventory/status accordingly.
